title: Reproducibility Archive for Fibonacci Character Sums at Rank Index Two and Jacobsthal Sums
description: Public reproducibility verifier and machine-readable output files for the manuscript "Fibonacci Character Sums at Rank Index Two and Jacobsthal Sums". The verifier checks finite-range evidence for rank-index-two Fibonacci character-sum identities and their reductions to Jacobsthal sums, separating theorem-level checks from exploratory checks and density context.
